Container.Name: AmberSight
Container.Overview: AmberSight is a self-hosted camera recording server: it records RTSP cameras, detects motion, checks it with built-in AI object detection, and sends alerts. Unraid passes the server's time zone (TZ), which schedules and quiet hours use. Open the web interface and add the first user under Settings > Users & security before anything else. Unraid support is new and has not been tested on Unraid yet; please report problems in Discussions.[br][br] The data folder holds the SQLite database. It is best kept off Unraid's /mnt/user layer (FUSE): on Unraid 6.12+ set the appdata share to Exclusive access, or point Data at /mnt/<your pool>/appdata/ambersight/data. To record to an array share, map it to /recordings (it must be writable by PUID:PGID, 99:100 by default; an existing share is fine) and choose /recordings in Settings > Recording > Drives & folders.[br][br] Bridge networking works for cameras added by address. Camera discovery (ONVIF) and battery Reolink cameras need host networking. For an NVIDIA card use the :cuda tag with the Nvidia Driver plugin and --runtime=nvidia.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web interface, API and live video (HTTP, or HTTPS once turned on in Settings).

Config.Name: RTMP port
Config.Description: Optional. Only used when cameras push RTMP to AmberSight; you can remove it otherwise.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.toml, written with starter settings on the first start.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, recordings (unless you add a recordings folder), AI models and backups. The database is SQLite and runs best off the /mnt/user (FUSE) layer: on Unraid 6.12+ set the appdata share to Exclusive access, or use /mnt/<your pool>/appdata/ambersight/data.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Optional. A share for recordings, e.g. /mnt/user/cameras. After the first start, choose /recordings in Settings > Recording > Drives & folders. The share must be writable by PUID:PGID (99:100 by default); an existing share is fine. Leave empty to record into the data folder.

Config.Name: Video device
Config.Description: Optional. Enter /dev/dri for Intel or AMD hardware video decode. Leave empty if the server has no such device (the container would not start).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User AmberSight runs as; it owns the config and data folders (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group AmberSight runs as (100 = users on Unraid).
